title: Holiday Decorating Made Easy
text: Holiday Decorating Made Easy. This bundle of Halloween themed decor makes holiday decorating easy! The items are a good quality, though the wood blocks look mass produced as opposed to hand painted. The pieces are a good start for decorating your tiered tray!

product_metadata.title: CRCZK Halloween Decor, 6 PCS Halloween Gnome Tiered Tray Decor Bundle, Halloween Witch Gnome Plush, Mini Buffalo Pillow, Halloween Wood Signs, Wooden Garland Halloween Home Office Decor
features: 【Packing Include】This bundle set includes one Halloween Witch Gnome Plush, 1 Mini Purple Buffalo Pillow, 3 Halloween Wood Signs,1 Wooden bead garland The Tiered Tray is NOT included.
【Great Craftsmanship】The Witch Gnome is made by professional artisans. There is sand at the bottom to make the gnome sit stably.The Mini Pillow is also friendly match Halloween theme.

【High Quality Halloween Signs】These mini wooden signs are made of High quality wooden blocks , All pieces have been laser cut,clearly painted. the thickness of wooden is 0.6inch which can support to stay upright by itself.
【Halloween Decor 】 It's excellent decor set for Halloween farmhouse tiered tray decor , display shelf , kitchen table and theme party ! And it's Durable for long time.

【Giftable】Halloween Theme Box Package.One Halloween theme are put together and you don't have to run all over finding things one by one.It will definitely win over any Gnome lover’s heart! Not only Halloween Gift , but also any holiday and Birthday gifts.
